# ibee_gpu_vm_snapshot (Resource)

An immutable VM snapshot. Creation waits for capture completion. Deletion removes this recovery point; restoring is an explicit operation outside this resource. The upstream mutation decides billing and lifecycle admission.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_gpu_vm_snapshot" "worker" {
  vm_id = "VM_ID"
  name  = "before-upgrade"
  mode  = "root_only"
  # Temporary: the API expects the snapshot storage SKU until it resolves it itself.
  billing_catalog = jsonencode({ sku_id = "SKU_ID", sku_code = "SKU_CODE" })
}
```

Attachments read it from the volume when omitted. Omitted values preserve prior state. Adding a previously absent value only records configuration. Changing a known value requires replacement. |
